items.text: SC and ST students can find free or subsidised skill courses through government skilling programmes, state corporations, industrial training institutes and some employers, and the best choice is a course that is recognised, linked to real local jobs and clear about what is free.
Check official skilling portals and your state welfare office, pick a recognised course tied to local jobs and keep your documents ready.
Read the current official notice and never pay an agent for admission.
